ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR25] Requires Budget Validated while in Solutioning, Negotiation or Booking Verification. Stage updated 2026-09-24 per IRM.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell') ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ),
ISPICKVAL(Budget_Validated__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Budget Validated is required to advance to the next stage. Please enter a value.
